hook.name: PhoenixV4ReturnDeltaHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for a PXT/USDC pool that charges buy and sell fees via swap delta adjustments rather than LP fees. Sells burn a fixed percentage of PXT and skim USDC at penalty rates, with an attribution rebate for sellers who identify themselves via attributeSell; buys are charged a USDC fee split between donation and marketing allocations.
